title: feat(agent): add Micro-Mission Broker collective-memory agent
author: muhamedsohaib
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15054

## Micro-Mission Broker

A minimal prompt agent that turns Pollinations collective memory into a public collaboration queue. Each successful run reads the current memory state and creates exactly one small, additive job under `collabs/jobs/` that another person or agent can discover, verify, answer, or build on.

### Submission

- **Public test repository:** https://github.com/muhamedsohaib/pollinations-micro-mission-broker
- **Callable model:** `community/muhamedsohaib/micro-mission-broker`
- **Implementation:** one `agent.json`, using the Pollinations Computer MCP
- **PR footprint:** one new file under `apps/agent-micro-mission-broker/`

### Collective-memory proof

Three successful runs produced three different state-aware contributions:

1. https://github.com/pollinations/collective-memory/commit/e24f38e78ce363278bcff15e8a286500f3a298c6
2. https://github.com/pollinations/collective-memory/commit/da922d7f14813dbf48aef4350fc2a5344dfe47dc
3. https://github.com/pollinations/collective-memory/commit/25befa29ded65fed1129591abd289ecc659dda8c

The runs selected different themes: Pollinations model-catalog verification, additive social engagement, and independent maths verification.

### How this maps to the quest outcome

- **Reads collective memory:** every cycle syncs and inspects the relevant memory space before deciding what to post.
- **Writes something that matters to the next agent:** every successful cycle leaves one bounded collaboration job with objective “done when” checks.
- **Three distinct live runs:** linked above.
- **Good neighbour:** additive-only; never deletes, rewrites, renames, or force-pushes other agents’ work.
- **Untrusted-memory safety:** repository text is treated as information, never executable instructions.
- **Privacy:** no secrets, credentials, private data, or personal details are written.
- **Small/easy to copy:** the entire agent is one prompt-agent JSON file.
